strategy_statement: Three wallets run by one engine (one order counter per wallet, restarted together daily at 01:00 UTC) quote BUY orders on both outcomes of BTC 5m Up/Down windows (and other crypto Up/Down markets) on the 0.01 grid, at or near the top of the book [exam-verified: top-of-book 0.01-grid maker]. Quotes follow a TWAP-60 fair value of Binance (best explained by the futures price at the match time) and are re-signed 10-23 times a second per wallet, more when Binance moves; moves older than about 1-1.5 s are already priced into its quotes, while the average other maker stays exposed for 3-5 s; it is not the fastest maker (sub-second makers own freshly repriced levels, and it is filled where its price stands alone or ahead of older orders) [VALIDATE-only/STUDY: requote window from calldata match clocks]. It bids the side its fair value says the market underprices, most clearly at the open, and keeps adding to the side it holds [exam-verified partially: side 0.65 vs 0.60]. Order size follows a clock schedule: 500 shares on weekdays from 12:00 to about 21:00 UTC, 62 or 250 at night and on weekends, with a one-fifth second level [STUDY + VALIDATE aggregate]. Which windows it trades is a switch inside the running engine (off overnight or on weekends on some days, back on at 12:00-15:30 UTC), invisible in public data [hypothesis: operator decision]. It holds to resolution. In busy periods most of its profit comes from buying both outcomes cheaply at different moments of a window (paired shares at an average Up + Down price of 0.89: +11% on paired dollars in VALIDATE) while the unpaired directional remainder loses; in quiet periods the directional part carried the profit. Plus a small rebate (8% of PnL); liquidity rewards are negligible ($0.81). Not decoded: when its bid is at the top of the book (the quote state), which caps the presence AUC near 0.73 even with oracle taker flow.

selection.description: BTC 5m enabled per period inside the running engine (not process restarts): on in weekday US hours; off overnight/weekends on some days (10-23 21:00 -> 10-24 15:25, 10-24 23:00 -> 10-25 13:33 UTC); 94.5% of VALIDATE windows active. No public correlate beyond the clock (+0.002 AUC).

timing.description: continuous requoting: 10-23 orders/s per wallet, rising with Binance activity (Spearman 0.67); exposed only to the last ~0.25-1.5 s of Binance moves (others 3-5 s); orders rest at the open and stop ~30 s before the end; fills follow a favourable 2-5 s move of the token. Not the fastest maker: at levels with a sub-0.5-s competing order it is almost never at the top (pilot).

side.description: side with the higher predicted presence (fair value vs market edge, opening strike gap, momentum of the token's fair): VALIDATE 0.66 vs 0.61 market-activity baseline (0.70 with own inventory); exam round 1 0.655 vs 0.600.

price.description: 0.01 grid at the best bid: last clean print on s minus 0.01 is within one tick for 71% of VALIDATE fills (exam 0.688); live pilot: fill price = best bid in 11 of 15; limit price corr 0.85 with a futures TWAP-60 fair at the match time. At the best price but usually behind part of the same-price queue (first in 31% of multi-maker matches).

size.description: clock schedule from calldata: 500 shares weekdays 12:00-~21:00 UTC, 62 (or 250) nights and weekends, second level one fifth (100/12/50); earlier ladders 500/1000 (10-09..16) and 500/250/125 (10-16..22); size does not depend on edge within a session.

exit.description: holds to resolution (REDEEM rows; occasional MERGE of pairs); in busy periods its paired Up+Down shares cost 0.89 on average (+11% on paired dollars in VALIDATE) and the unpaired remainder loses (-7.3%); adds to the side it holds. Merges the whole paired amount about 65 s before the end in 13% of paired windows (STUDY).
